reviews.text: Dr Hurley & Nurse Kayleen were amazingly kind.  I was a nervous wreck and they made me feel better about my doggies dental issue.  I was able to get an urgent same day appointment.  Everyone was amazing from the front desk staff to the medical personnel, they explained everything and all the options.  Definitely recommend 10/10

We found a kitty on the roadside on a road trip across the country, called and got a same day apt. They were kind, informed us of the process for lost cats, and when she turned up not belonging to anyone, helped get us on track to take her home safely, as we have other kitties at home. One of the most polite and courteous vet hospitals I have ever experienced. They even gave our dog a gift bag full of treats for just being along for the ride. Definitely recommend!!! 10/10

I have lived in the USA for 25 years. I work in animal welfare science, have taught at vet schools in the US and the UK and served on the AVMA committee for AWJAC. I have no hesitation saying that this was the best veterinary hospital interaction I have had in those 25 years. From front desk, to customer service rep, to vet tech, to veterinarian - all excellent, thoughtful and caring. Thanks to all the team for your help!

We booked with partners to get European Health Certificates for our 3 beagles and I could not say enough good things about Samantha and the team. She was so incredibly organised and thorough that it took a load of stress out of a scary process. She even found errors from the paperwork of other clinics and was on it immediately.
The whole team were kind and gentle with our ex-laboratory beagles and turns out they’re ’fear-free’ accredited which made sense. Highly recommend - this hospital was by far the best clinic I’ve been to since moving to the U.S. about 6 years ago.
Dr.Stricker & Nurse Kaylee were an absolute delight. I brought in a my new kitty for her wellness check. Everyone is so incredibly nice here.

Irene, Shawnda, and Dr. Hernandez were all excellent! They created such a calm and welcome environment for my anxious dog and I was really impressed with how relaxed they were able to make her feel as we discussed treatment options. Highly recommend!

An extraordinary experience! Nurse Irene and Dr. Gerardo are exceptional people. They gave my pet excellent care, showing him so much patience and affection. I highly recommend this place; the service was 10 out of 10, and the fact that they also speak Spanish was a huge help.
Great first visit with Irene & Dr. Hernandez.  Initial visit was to establish care and they really listened to my pups full history, made sure all my questions were answered and didn’t feel rushed.

Such a great place to take your pet! I took my cat here after recently adopting her from the shelter and all the staff members and medical professionals were incredibly kind and informative. Will certainly be my go-to spot for years!

Terrible customer service, expect deflective responses to simple clarifying questions. As a paying customer I should be able to ask for guidance on what to expect with the medication they provided. Google shouldn’t be more useful than college educated Vets. Take your hard earned money elsewhere.
Our puppy Maizey loves it here, appreciate the cruelty free approach and guidance particularly as new dog owners.
Amazing vet! Took such good care of my kitten when I brought him in. Very compassionate and give him so very many pet treats!

This is the best vet I have found in Chicago.  All of the doctors are very personable and genuinely care about the current and continued health of my feline, Thoth's wellbeing.  What I have paid has always felt reasonable without extra padding and all costs are given upfront before any procedure is administered.
Such a great place! Very accommodating and kind. Front desk staff is wonderful.

Will, thank you for the 5 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ We’re doing a little happy dance over here! 💙🐾
We truly appreciate your support and are so glad you chose Partners Animal Hospital West Loop for your pet’s care. We look forward to seeing you both again! 🐶🐱
Shawnda, Practice Manager

Brisa, thank you for the 5 stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ You officially made our tails wag! 🐾💙
We appreciate the love and support and are so happy to have you as part of the Partners family. See you next time! 😊🐶🐱
Shawnda, Practice Manager …
Just recently switched over to this office and I loved speaking with dr. Hernandez and nurse Irene about my concerns. They weren’t pushing medication which I loved.
Amazing experience! Our puppy loves coming here! Made him feel safe and welcomed!
Very friendly, informative, thorough, helpful & professional doctor & staff. Very pleased with our visit!
